summary: Master PropTech innovations, smart buildings, and digital transformation. Learn to implement high-ROI real estate technology. Enroll today with TrainingCred.
lede: PropTech venture capital concerns funding for companies developing digital technologies for real estate. For asset, investment, operations and development professionals, this course explores funding trends and supports evaluating and applying technology across property portfolios and projects. Participants work with property data and automated valuation models, plan IoT-enabled building workflows, and assess technology investments alongside topics such as BIM, tenant engagement and ESG monitoring.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level training is essential for professionals responsible for the strategic and operational performance of real estate assets in a technology-driven market.
modules: The PropTech Ecosystem and Market Drivers
Data Analytics and Automated Valuation Models
Blockchain and Tokenization in Real Estate
Cybersecurity and Data Privacy in PropTech
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in real estate management, investment, or development. A basic understanding of property financial modeling and facility operations is required. No prior coding or advanced technical knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with standard real estate software (e.g., Yardi, MRI, or Argus) is beneficial.
